correctness.summary: Run is an unimplemented stub: it only sets matchResident[i]=-1 and runs no Gale-Shapley (hospital/residents) matching, so every resident is left unmatched regardless of preferences/capacities.
correctness.triggeringInput: numResidents=2, numHospitals=1, hospitalCapacities={2}, residentPref={0,0} (each resident prefers hospital 0), hospitalPref={0,1}. Stable matching assigns both residents to hospital 0 (capacity 2); actual leaves matchResident[0]=matchResident[1]=-1.
correctness.rootCause: The resident-proposing Gale-Shapley loop (propose, accept up to capacity, evict worst when over capacity) is not implemented; only initialization is present.
correctness.suggestedFix: Implement resident-proposing deferred acceptance using hospital preference ranks and capacities: each free resident proposes down their list; a hospital provisionally accepts while under capacity and otherwise evicts its least-preferred current resident; iterate until stable, writing matchResident[].

perf.summary: Stub: only initializes matchResident to -1; the Gale-Shapley hospital/residents algorithm is unimplemented and the preference/capacity parameters are unused.
perf.currentCost: Single O(numResidents) init loop; no matching computed.
perf.proposedChange: Implement resident-proposing Gale-Shapley with per-hospital capacity heaps, or document as init-only. The single init loop is already minimal.
perf.rationale: No safe constant-factor win exists on a lone init loop; the signal is the missing algorithm body.
perf.risk: Implementing changes observable outputs by design.
